name: TagGroup
summary: Displays removable labels in a collection.

useWhen: Showing the filters currently applied, each removable
avoidWhen: Choosing several predefined values; use TagSelect

obligations: Expose tag collection and removal actions.

behavior: Removal passes the removed items to onRemove as item records, not ids.
Each tag shows a remove button only when onRemove is supplied.
With onRemove supplied, Backspace or Delete on a focused tag also removes it.
A disabled tag cannot be removed.
TagGroup does not change its items: the application removes the reported items from the items it passes.
accessibility: Expose tag collection and removal actions.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
